name: PI Industries
title: Presentation of Earnings Conference Call pertaining to the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026

read.thesis: Q2 consolidated revenue fell 9% to Rs 17,018 Mn as agchem exports dropped ~18% on pricing pressure, while domestic grew 19%; PAT fell 70% and no FY27 guidance is restated in the deck.

capex.quote: Total capex for H1 FY27 stood at INR 5,674 Mn, reflecting continued investment in efficiencies, capacities, new initiatives and R&D.

triggers.label: Agchem exports down ~18% on genericization
triggers.quote: Agchem exports decline by ~18% · Focus on volume growth post genericization through price optimisation

triggers.label: Cost escalation not passed through
triggers.quote: Cost escalation not actively passed through under current market conditions

triggers.label: NWC days down 18 to 121
triggers.quote: Net Working Capital reduced by 18 Days (139 days in Mar 26 to 121 days in Sep-26) releasing INR 2,981 Mn cash.

guidance.quote: Expect acceleration of growth through new products; 5+ to be commercialized in FY27

guidance.value: Margins to normalize once volatility subsides
guidance.quote: Margins to normalize once volatility subsides

red_flags.label: Export pricing pressure and margin compression
red_flags.quote: Pricing pressure due to El Nino & genericization

growth.why: Management expects growth to accelerate through 5+ new product commercialisations in FY27 and says global biologicals grew 250%, but no revenue percentage guidance, capacity additions, or numeric timeline for margin normalisation are given.
